blocks: When he was killed in the senate house, after four years Lepidus, Antony and Octavian, the grandson of the aforesaid Caesar's sister through her daughter, were appointed triumvirs. Of these, when Lepidus had died, and he had defeated Antony, the husband of Queen Cleopatra, in a sea battle, the aforesaid Octavian, first called Augustus, held the empire alone for fifty-six years.
